scope: Independent visual inspection of seven original standalone Mac JPEG captures, without editing images, operating gameplay or inspecting mechanics archives.
result: Bounded visual acceptance passes; no material UI, temper-result, equipment or restart presentation regression was found.

named_next_gap.issue: Generic gray-green bottle does not distinguish burning coating at a glance. Text truthfully identifies it.
named_next_gap.priority_scope: One product identity/portrait treatment if independently supported by catalog and mechanics review; do not infer a new mechanical state or redraw the accepted sword.

images.observation: Burning coating title and mechanics are legible, including quench use and burning intensity 1. The native portrait is a generic muted gray-green bottle and does not visually distinguish the burning product; this is a bounded identity gap, not evidence of a broken transaction.

The forge menu visibly marks burning coating and long sword as picked; Craft and details/accept/back controls are legible on the panel. No missing price or truncated selected-item identity is visible.
Menu closes without stale panel remnants. The log explicitly reports quenching the flame-quenched long sword and consuming the coating; weight is now 28/270, HP 25/42 and drams 40.

Full flame-quenched long sword name fits the row and left-hand slot; 1d8 and far-right [E] remain clear. The native sword portrait is coherent, and the intentional preview ellipsis has an F1 Details route.

Reader page 1/2 clearly displays flame-quenched identity, 1d8 damage, +2 penetration, separate 25% bleeding and 30% set-ablaze attempts, and currently equipped left hand. Portrait and page controls are clean.

After the documented restart the flame-quenched name, left-hand assignment, 1d8, [E], weight 28/270, HP 25/42 and drams 40 match the prior accepted visible state. A different focused empty body slot is not an item-state regression.
Restart reader page 1/2 matches the pre-restart identity, sword portrait, damage, penetration, independent proc descriptions and equipped left-hand text.

limits: These stills do not independently prove exact entity identity, resin 2-to-1, inventory absence or coating consumption. Those require the separate saved-state/archive audit.
The root-provided actual CUA sequence supplies action and full-restart provenance; images show the observed results rather than input execution.
Only sword reader page 1 of 2 was reviewed. No claim that page 2 or all possible long item names were exercised.
No Linux execution, physical controller/Steam Deck, combat proc execution or broader graphics-completion claim.
mutations: Only this scratch JSON report was written; repository, Unity, player and captures were not changed.
